text:
maya_sales: Hey team — prepping the Acme POC. They asked about on‑prem airgapped packaging + upgrade cadence. Quick Qs: can we support signed delta bundles + HSM-backed key ops for activation?

arjun_se: short answer: yes, but a few constraints. We currently support signed full bundles for airgap installs and a delta bundle flow that requires an out-of-band manifest. HSM-backed signing (customer KMS/HSM) is supported in Private but needs a handshake during provisioning.

priya_security: important: customer requires FIPS‑140 KMS and hardware attestation for bootstrapping. We'll need to validate our offline bootstrap protocol against their compliance checklist (they flagged key rotation cadence).

maya_sales: they pushed back on downtime. They want patch cadence <= monthly with non-disruptive binary swaps. Can we do rolling upgrades without external connectivity?

jamal_infra: rolling upgrades are possible if the bundle contains all artifacts and the orchestrator is allowed to restart nodes. For fully disconnected sites, you need a maintenance window and a controller that can run the rollout plan locally. We can do orchestration via the offline operator, but we assume customer provides jumpbox for operator control.

alice_acme: to be clear: no internet, no outbound allowed from the cluster. We can use a one-time sideload via thumbdrive or a staging jumpbox that has controlled egress. Also: we need audit trail of who applied which bundle.

arjun_se: ack. For the audit trail we provide signed manifests with the operator logging the bundle ID + signer. Operator logs are tamper-evident when combined with SBOM signatures. Example manifest snippet we expect:

```
{"bundle_id": "rwd-2026-03-01-01","signed_by": "redwood-signing-v1","sha256": "3b7f...eaf9"}
```

priya_security: two notes: 1) We must provide guidance on key custody when customer requests HSM — document who rotates keys and how to revoke. 2) Delta bundles complicate SBOM provenance; customer may ask for reproducible builds.

maya_sales: pricing question: they want an explicit offline support add-on + signed bundle cost. Do we have a standardized SKU for airgap monthly support / patch pipeline?

tom_legal: from contracting view, we typically add a "sealed environment" fee + extended support line item. Need to confirm on pricing desk but expect a non-refundable setup fee and monthly maintenance. Also add SLAs caveat for offline upgrade windows.

jamal_infra: operational constraints to call out for the SOW: max bundle size (we recommend <= 10GB for jumpbox transfers), recommended delta window (we support binary diffs but customer must keep base image pinned), and an emergency rollback artifact included in each bundle.

alice_acme: 10GB is fine. For rollback we need a certified rollback policy and a snapshot taken pre-upgrade. Can you specify how snapshots are triggered offline?

arjun_se: operator can trigger checkpoints locally; we ship a small CLI that runs on jumpbox: `rwdctl snapshot --out /mnt/snapshots/backup-$(date +%s).tar` The CLI signs the snapshot metadata with the operator key. We'll include instructions.

priya_security: add: snapshot encryption at rest with AES‑GCM and key stored in customer HSM. We should draft a short appendix for their security questionnaire (items about KMS, signing algs, SBOM, patch cadence).

maya_sales: action items: Arjun -> draft ops checklist + CLI usage; Priya -> security appendix & key rotation doc; Jamal -> recommended bundle size limits & offline rollout playbook; Tom -> propose contract fee language. I'll consolidate and send to Acme.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: generated offline bundle template `rwd-offline-bundle-v1.tar.gz` (size estimate: 6.8GB). Manifest scaffold saved to `/tmp/offline-manifest-3642109876.json`.

maya_sales: thanks — aim to have the SOW + appendix by EOD tomorrow so they can review before their security council meeting. :thumbsup:
